lines.text: که چون شمس با ول هر برجی حلول کند و بسعد ناظر باشد دلالت بخیر و سلامتی و ایمنی و صلاح
lines.en: that when the Sun enters the first of any sign and aspects a benefic, it indicates goodness, safety, security, and righteousness

lines.text: حال رعیت و شفقت یافتن ایشان از پادشاه و کثرت سعی مردم در صنایع و اگر بنحسی ناظر
lines.en: of the condition of the subjects, and their finding compassion from the king, and the abundance of people's effort in crafts; and if it aspects a malefic,

lines.text: باشد حکم بر ضد و عکس باشد در ان ماه (حلول افتاب در برج حمل) دلالت کند بر عدل
lines.en: the judgment is the opposite and reverse in that month. (The entry of the Sun into the sign of Aries) indicates justice

lines.text: و راستی ملوک و قوة حال فرماندهان و اعتدال هوا و بارانهای نافع و زیادتی آبها و فرج
lines.en: and rectitude of kings, and the strength of the condition of commanders, and the moderation of the air, and beneficial rains, and the increase of waters, and relief

lines.text: در خلایق و ارزانی اطعمه و رعد و برق و میل پادشاه بسواری و سفر و ملک گیری و ترهیب
lines.en: among the creatures, and the cheapness of foods, and thunder and lightning, and the inclination of the king to riding, traveling, conquering lands, and terrifying

lines.text: یافتن امراء و لشکریان از پادشاه و رفعت قدر اهل سلاح و غلاء ذهب و فضه و ظهور
lines.en: the finding of emirs and soldiers from the king, and the elevation of the rank of the people of arms, and the dearness of gold and silver, and the appearance

lines.text: شخصی از جانب مشرق (حلول افتاب در برج ثور) دلالت کند بر فساد بازارها و عزت طعام
lines.en: of a person from the direction of the east. (The entry of the Sun into the sign of Taurus) indicates the corruption of markets, and the dearness of food,

lines.text: و تغییر هوا و بسیاری عمارتها و امدن باران و وزیدن باد و چون باخر برج رسد رعد و برق
lines.en: and the change of the air, and the abundance of buildings, and the coming of rain, and the blowing of wind; and when it reaches the end of the sign, thunder and lightning

lines.text: و صاعقه باشد و حسن زراعات و غلات و سلامتی گاو و گوسفند و بسیاری عدل و داد
lines.en: and thunderbolts will occur, and the goodness of crops and grains, and the safety of cows and sheep, and the abundance of justice and equity,

lines.text: و سکونت مردم بایمنی در مساکن و اوطان و قوت یافتن دواب و خرید و فروخت ستوران
lines.en: and the dwelling of people in safety in residences and homelands, and the gaining of strength by beasts of burden, and the buying and selling of livestock,

lines.text: و خوبی حال شکوفه (حلول افتاب در برج جوزا) دلالت کند بر کساد بازارها و بیماری
lines.en: and the goodness of the condition of blossoms. (The entry of the Sun into the sign of Gemini) indicates the stagnation of markets, and the illness

lines.text: کودکان از حصبه و ابله و قوة حال ملوک و حرارت هوا و امدن باران در مواضع مستعد
lines.en: of children from measles and smallpox, and the strength of the condition of kings, and the heat of the air, and the coming of rain in places prepared

lines.text: و قوة ابها و رونق دیوانها و گذشتن احکام و امثله سلاطین و سلامتی ارتفاعات و اشجار
lines.en: and the strength of waters, and the flourishing of divans, and the passing of judgments and examples of sultans, and the safety of crops and trees,

lines.text: و کثرت ارسال مکاتبات و مراسلات میانه ملوک و فرماندهان و بودن اراجیف و حدوث
lines.en: and the abundance of sending correspondence and letters between kings and commanders, and the existence of rumors, and the occurrence

lines.text: اخبار موحشه و بسیاری حیله و مکر و تعمیر مواضع شریفه (حلول افتاب در برج سرطان)
lines.en: of terrifying news, and the abundance of trickery and deceit, and the repairing of noble places. (The entry of the Sun into the sign of Cancer)

lines.text: دلالت کند بر کثرت و عظمت پادشاه و عزت اشراف و اتفاق سفر پادشاهی و خوشحالی رعیت
lines.en: indicates the abundance and greatness of the king, and the honor of the nobles, and the occurrence of a royal journey, and the happiness of the subjects

lines.text: از ان و نیکی حال مسافران و خروج خوارج بر بعضی از ملوک جانب مشرق و سلامتی کشتیها
lines.en: from that, and the goodness of the condition of travelers, and the emergence of Kharijites against some of the kings of the eastern direction, and the safety of ships,

lines.text: و گرمی هوا و کثرت ابها و ارزانی غلات و بسیاری منفعت صیادان و رواج کار ایشان *
lines.en: and the heat of the air, and the abundance of waters, and the cheapness of grains, and the abundance of profit for hunters, and the currency of their work. *

lines.text: (حلول افتاب در برج اسد) دلالت کند بر قوت حال ملوک و فرماندهان و عدل ایشان
lines.en: (The entry of the Sun into the sign of Leo) indicates the strength of the condition of kings and commanders, and their justice

lines.text: نسبت بضعفاء و شدت گرما و ارزانی غلات و کرانی و قیمت طلا و مس و وقوع مخاصمه
lines.en: towards the weak, and the intensity of heat, and the cheapness of grains, and the dearness and price of gold and copper, and the occurrence of dispute

lines.text: در ولایت روم و کساد بازارها و ارزانی نرخها و بسیاری خیرات و غلبه خون در ابدان و
lines.en: in the province of Rome, and the stagnation of markets, and the cheapness of prices, and the abundance of charities, and the dominance of blood in bodies, and

lines.text: قوة حال صرافان و ضرابان و افراط حرارت هوا و انتقال پادشاه از شهری بشهری و صلاح
lines.en: the strength of the condition of moneychangers and minters, and the excess of the heat of the air, and the transfer of the king from one city to another, and the righteousness

lines.text: احوال دواب و خوبی میوها (حلول افتاب در برج سنبله دلالت کند بر ارزانی غلات و رواج
lines.en: of the conditions of beasts of burden, and the goodness of fruits. (The entry of the Sun into the sign of Virgo indicates the cheapness of grains and the currency

Entry of the Sun into Aries

summary.headline: Solar Ingresses: Aries to Virgo
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the Sun’s entry into Aries through Virgo, including effects on kings, subjects, weather, rain, crops, markets, prices, warfare, health, travel, and social order. A general rule contrasts benefic and malefic aspects, followed by detailed forecasts for each sign.
